You are changing one Cloudflare Worker model profile in freytag-forge. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no live model call, no deployment. Do not git commit. NEVER print or write any credential. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: worker/src/models.js and worker/test/models.test.js. Never touch worker/src/index.js, Python, data or docs.

BACKGROUND: worker/src/models.js has MODEL_PROFILES. The profile for @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast currently reuses buildLlamaBody, which sends response_format and temperature 0 whenever the request carries a response_format. Measured on the real model: with JSON mode forced, 0 of 6 narration replies were valid JSON; with JSON mode off and default sampling, 20 of 20 were valid after the Python repair step. So this model must never receive response_format, and must use the model's default sampling (no temperature field).

CHANGE: give the 70B profile its own body builder (for example buildLlamaPlainBody) that returns only messages (system then user) and max_tokens, and ignores the responseFormat argument entirely: no response_format key and no temperature key, even when the request asked for JSON mode. The 8B default profile (@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast) and the DeepSeek profile must keep their exact current behaviour. Keep the extractor, price and ceiling of the 70B profile unchanged. Add a short comment on why the 70B profile ignores response_format (one or two plain sentences).

TESTS FIRST in worker/test/models.test.js, in the style of the existing tests there (reuse its env, request, runWithFetch, aiResponse helpers; read the file first): (1) with CF_AI_MODEL set to the 70B model and a request body that includes response_format {type: 'json_object'}, the body sent to Workers AI has no response_format and no temperature, keeps the messages and max_tokens; (2) the same request through the default 8B model still sends response_format json_object and temperature 0 (add this only if no existing test already asserts it; do not duplicate); (3) the 70B model via an allowed X-Bench-Model header also sends no response_format. Run `cd worker && node --test test/` and see (1) and (3) fail before the change, then make the change and see all pass.

FINISH: `node --check worker/src/models.js`. Report the pass counts.
